comment: sptd mode only, temporary until CAS delivers these files. Expects configmap/manifests/manifest.sptd.template.yaml and configmap/manifests/scone.sptd.template.yaml (one sptd source image per reader). Each reader's ConfigMap volume is baked into its sealed launcher as descriptor files (opened as /proc/self/fd/N), numbered by path: reader-1 file1.txt 100, file2.json 101; reader-2 server.crt 100, your_python_script.py 101. folder-reader lists /config and reads each entry; the sptd source image (scripts/sptd/images/configmap) ships /config as a directory of symlinks to those descriptors, and the dispatcher checks the links.
